headline: L137 registers the post-hoc observation that B947's thinning pattern holds on the five VALUE families and fails on the two PENCIL CUBICS. Scouting finds that this description is not merely un-sealed but FALSE on material banked in this repo before B947 ran: T, B914's colorless coupling invariant -- registered in docs/LAW_MAP.md:197 as THE ONE-NUMBER TABLE, 'all six NORMALIZATION-FREE colorless couplings EXACTLY equal', filed in LAW_MAP section F 'The measurement cascade and the value layer' -- is a value-layer family by every criterion the programme applies, and it FAILS B947's pattern on BOTH extreme conditions (|P_lead| >= 4, |P_const| = 5, both > 2), and fails INVARIANTLY (F >= 6). Two further independent findings make any value/pencil seal impossible in principle: (2) all seven B941 families generate ONE AND THE SAME cubic field K = Q[s]/(s^3-12s-5), verified here at 138 primes with zero splitting-type mismatches, so the split cannot be an arithmetic distinction between classes of object -- it is a distinction between which ELEMENT of K each family picks and in which Q*-normalisation; (3) B947's statistic is NOT AN INVARIANT of a pencil cubic, and this repo banks mu in two normalisations (B866's t and B941/B947's rho = 13t) that give DIFFERENT P_const and DIFFERENT total support for the same locus. A definitional, genuinely pre-statable criterion DOES exist ('intrinsically-normalised element of K' vs 'locus in a pencil with a free coordinate scale') but it does not predict the outcome, so sealing on it would seal a false statement.

finding_2_one_field.consequence: The five that hold and the two that fail are seven DIFFERENT ELEMENTS OF ONE FIELD in seven different Q*-normalisations. No arithmetic mechanism is available to make a value/pencil prediction mean anything.

The disagreement is reported, not suppressed.

d_literature.note: No literature was needed and none is claimed. The invariant identified in section 4 of SCOUT.md is the p-adic Newton polygon of the cubic under the multiplicative reparameterisation of its variable; the statement 'p is forced into an extreme unless all three roots share one integral p-adic valuation' is elementary Newton-polygon bookkeeping, derived in-sandbox, and is labelled as such rather than attributed.

the_salvageable_invariant.definition: F(P) := number of primes p that cannot be pushed out of BOTH extreme coefficients by any reparameterisation t -> t/c, c in Q*. Equivalently: the number of primes whose p-adic Newton polygon of P is not a straight segment of integer slope; equivalently, the number of primes at which the three roots do not all share one integral p-adic valuation.
the_salvageable_invariant.why_it_is_the_real_content_of_B947: |P_lead| <= 2 and |P_const| <= 2 REQUIRE F <= 4 (the two extremes hold at most 4 forced primes between them) -- that is the whole 'thin extremes' half; |P_mid_only| >= 1 requires at least one UNFORCED prime to be present -- that is the whole 'fat middle' half.
the_salvageable_invariant.invariance_check: tilt scan g in [-60, 60]; F values unchanged from the narrower [-12, 12] scan
the_salvageable_invariant.observed_range: 1 to >=6 across ten families; both outcomes live, so the reformulation is non-vacuous
the_salvageable_invariant.reading_for_V: V's forced primes are {2, 3, 953}. 953^4 in the leading coefficient IS B918's 'its denominator ideal is the observer's place to the fourth power'; {2,3} is the norm. The unforced primes 13, 17, 1129, 421493 are exactly B946's degree-graded residue, unforced BECAUSE they live only in e1/e2. Same fact B946 banked, now stated normalisation-free.
the_salvageable_invariant.honest_status: SCOUTING-LEVEL. F is computed, not proved to be the unique right invariant, and no mechanism is claimed for why any family has the F it has.

recommendations: CLOSE L137 as REFUTED (not unsealable), naming T as the counterexample. B947's refusal to rescue was correct and this is its strongest vindication.
Do NOT seal any successor in the B947 coefficient-support form: it is not an invariant of a pencil-coordinate object, and its vacuity exclusion is not invariant either.

If a successor is wanted, seal the F-form against the FULL banked census rather than a chosen seven. The question worth pre-registering is the MECHANISM one: for an element of K, is F <= 3 equivalent to some banked structural property (e.g. divisor supported on the observer's place plus the norm primes)?
